item.title: Mahesh Edible Oil signs Ranbir Kapoor for SALONI and STAYFIT brands
item.description: Mahesh Edible Oil Industries has appointed Ranbir Kapoor as brand ambassador for its flagship brands SALONI (Mustard Oil and Soya Chunks) and STAYFIT. The move is part of the company’s efforts to strengthen brand visibility and expand its presence across markets in India. item.title: Charged Pro debuts in India with anime-style film
item.description: Coca-Cola has launched Charged Pro, a new beverage positioned in the energy and soda segment, in India. The launch is supported by an anime-inspired film created using traditional cel animation techniques. Conceptualised by WPP OpenX in partnership with Ogilvy Gurugram and produced by Hungry Films, the film uses hand-drawn animation layered frame by frame. item.title: Lilly launches multi-starrer obesity awareness campaign
item.description: Eli Lilly and Company (India) has announced the next phase of its obesity awareness initiative with a new integrated campaign aimed at encouraging a more informed and empathetic conversation around obesity. The campaign brings together lived experiences and scientific perspectives to move the discussion away from appearance and judgment, while reinforcing the role of doctors in obesity care. item.title: TV9’s ‘Duologue with Barun Das’ returns with Season 4
item.description: TV9 Network’s interview series ‘Duologue with Barun Das’ is set to return with its fourth season on 28 February 2026. The show, presented by Radico, features conversations between Barun Das, MD and CEO, TV9 Network, and personalities from sport, cinema and global culture. item.title: Pulse Candy marks World Compliment Day with ‘Pulse of Moving India’
item.description: DS Group’s Pulse Candy has announced the sixth edition of its World Compliment Day initiative for 2026, titled ‘Pulse of Moving India’. item.title: DH Bengaluru 2040 Summit focuses on city’s future roadmap
item.description: The fifth edition of the DH Bengaluru 2040 Summit, organised by Deccan Herald, was held on 20 February at Shangri-La Bengaluru. The annual event brought together policymakers, industry leaders, entrepreneurs and academics to discuss the city’s long-term development. item.title: Paramount to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery in $110 billion deal
item.description: Paramount Skydance Corporation and Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) have entered into a definitive merger agreement under which Paramount will acquire WBD, creating a combined global media and entertainment company. The transaction values WBD at an enterprise value of $110 billion and is expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and shareholder consent. item.description: Myntra has appointed Mansi Agarwal as senior director – business development. item.title: adidas Originals unveils new global chapter for Superstar
item.description: adidas Originals has unveiled the latest global chapter of its Superstar franchise, marking the return of the iconic sneaker with a new Spring 2026 campaign.
